## When it is selected

- **Plan review:** when any of: `publicContract` (Public API, RPC contract, DTO, serialization/wire format, public interface, externally visible error or cancellation behaviour); `config` (Configuration schema or defaults that consumers set or rely on)
- **Slice review:** when any of: `publicContract` (Public API, RPC contract, DTO, serialization/wire format, public interface, externally visible error or cancellation behaviour); `config` (Configuration schema or defaults that consumers set or rely on)
